summary: This is a controlled integration-test fixture. It provides a revision-pinned accepted intent, Work Contract, and evidence package without changing product code.

acceptanceCriteria.AC1: The card will be moved manually into Agent Review after this fixture is pushed.
acceptanceCriteria.AC2: The evaluator preflight must validate the three committed handoff artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria.AC3: The orchestrator must post the evaluator response to the card.

validation.fixture: The committed handoff artifacts have matching work-item IDs, intent hash, and Work Contract hash.
validation.integration: The actual Trello and NAS evaluator interaction is intentionally executed after this fixture is pushed.

risks: The fixture evaluates integration evidence rather than a product change.
